gloss: from the beginning; from the start

definitions.gloss: from the beginning; from the start; from the outset
definitions.explanation: Starting from the very beginning of something. Can indicate either a temporal starting point or that something was the case all along.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めから⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧。
examples.english: To start over from the beginning.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めから⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{分|わ}かっていた→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I knew from the start that it was impossible.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{初|はじ}めから⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{離|はな}せなかった→離す：19372_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't take my eyes off this movie from beginning to end.

notes:
A common adverbial phrase combining ⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧ (beginning) with the particle ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from). Used to emphasize that something applies from the very start — whether redoing a task, or expressing that a situation was true all along.

USAGE:
Often implies emphasis or mild frustration — '{初|はじ}めから⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧' (you should have said so from the start). Also used neutrally to describe starting a process from step one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初|はじ}めから⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧ — to redo from scratch
- {初|はじ}めから⟦{終|お}わり→終わり：01361_owari⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧ — from start to finish
- {初|はじ}めから⟦{分|わ}かっていた→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ — knew all along
- {初|はじ}めから⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧だった — it was impossible from the start

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ — from the very first; slightly more formal and emphatic
- もともと — originally, from the beginning; emphasizes an inherent quality
- ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ — from the original point; similar to もともと
